messages:
Aisha (partnerships): Quick heads-up — GateFlow + VertexEdge want a coordinated launch in the marketplace + joint announcement. Need a short playbook: marketplace listing cadence, co-marketing assets, SI cutover window, and engineering roll/fallback plan. Who can own which lane?
Tom (eng): I can handle the engineering cutover plan and fallback. Need to know target model variant and expected QPS for initial pilot.
Marcos (product): Target: `gflow-v2-small` quantized variant for GA pilot. Expected steady QPS ~120, spike to 400 for demos. Also want SDK samples for LangChain + LlamaIndex.
Elena (marketing): I'll own co-marketing assets + PR embargo timeline. Proposed: announce 2 weeks after marketplace listing, 3 press bullets, partner quotes. Need logos and short customer blurb from VertexEdge.
Ravi (SI): VertexEdge confirmed a small pilot customer (healthcare) but they're on strict compliance — we need private deployment checklist for Private offering and a chart of dataflow for Legal.
LegalBot: Please attach a dataflow diagram and the SI contract redlines by EOD Wed. Also flag any PHI exposure — we need the DPA addendum.
Tom (eng): For cutover: propose a 2-hour blackout window in a low-traffic period, pre-warm dedicated pool, run smoke tests:
```
- deploy canary -> run e2e smoke (langchain sample) -> verify latency < 200ms p95 -> promote
- rollback on >2 failed smoke checks or error rate spike >1%
```
Aisha (partnerships): Nice. Elena, marketing needs a dev-friendly sample app showing LangChain integration + gateway orchestration. Marcos, can product ship a tiny reference app?
Marcos (product): Yes — we can ship a `langchain-gateway-demo` repo with two quickstart notebooks (LangChain + LlamaIndex). Will include config for marketplace params and `orchestrator.yaml` snippet. ETA: 6 business days.
Elena (marketing): I'll prep the landing copy and a one-minute demo video. Need short script and a screen capture of the console with latency/cost numbers. Tom — can we capture token-level cost breakdown from the console for the clip?
Tom (eng): Yep, can export a per-route cost CSV from Redwood Console. I'll add a `console-export.sh` snippet to the demo repo.
Aisha (partnerships): Logistics: proposed timeline -> marketplace listing by Apr 12, private pilot cutover Apr 19, joint press Apr 26. Objections?
Ravi (SI): For healthcare pilot, we need on-prem deployment option available by Apr 19. That requires a cert checklist: KMS integration + audit logs.
Tom (eng): On-prem packaging: we have a v1 private bundle that supports KMS and audit logging, but CA cert churn needs manual step. I'll add a runbook.
LegalBot: Confirmed DPA addendum required. I'll draft and loop in VertexEdge legal.
Elena (marketing): Approve timeline pending legal. I'll schedule PR dry run for Apr 22.
Aisha (partnerships): Owners: Aisha (overall), Tom (engineering cutover & runbook), Marcos (ref app & product docs), Elena (assets + PR), Ravi (SI ops), LegalBot (contracts). I'll post a shared checklist tomorrow. :party_parrot:
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: marketplace-snapshot job will run 2024-04-10 02:00 UTC — ensure listing fields are final before then.
Aisha (partnerships): Thanks all — next sync Wed 10am PT. If anyone hits blockers, ping me here.
